notes: SI.FI is an IP-based, PoE-powered automation/control gateway for motorized shades and projection screens (Somfy SDN ecosystem), integrating with Control4, Crestron, Savant, and Alexa. It is now DISCONTINUED per the manufacturer, superseded by the TRO.Y device — treat specs as historical/legacy. Physical connector types for Port 1 and Port 2 are inferred: manufacturer copy describes them functionally ("RS232 input or RS485/Power input", "485 input") as pluggable terminal blocks rather than DE-9 connectors, so they were mapped to the rs232/rs485 connector ids per the allowed list rather than a generic euroblock id. No bandwidth/version grade applies to any port (no SDI/HDMI/DP/USB/Ethernet-speed spec was published — Ethernet speed for the PoE module was not stated, so grade was omitted). Unit also has two internal expansion-module bays (PoE module included; WiFi (WEC MK I) and Zigbee 3.0 (ZEC MK I) modules sold separately) — not modeled as ports since they are internal card slots, not external I/O. Dimensions 3.53" L x 2.375" W x 2.125" H, DIN-rail mountable, indoor use only, ABS housing, 1 lb. Primary source used: manufacturer page https://www.screeninnovations.com/accessories/si.fi (mirrored identically at https://www.shadeinnovations.com/accessories/si.fi); a full spec sheet/quick manual PDF with pinout diagrams exists on Screen Innovations' support library (support.screeninnovations.com) but could not be opened directly to confirm exact pin assignments.

ports.name: Ethernet (PoE)
ports.note: PoE 48V DC network/control uplink to router; up to 328 ft of Cat5e. Physical jack is provided via the included PoE expansion card (PEC MK II) in one of the unit's two expansion bays.

ports.name: Port 1 (RS-232 / RS-485 + Power)
ports.note: Single pluggable terminal block configurable as an RS-232 serial input or as RS-485 with optional 24V DC backup power input (consumes 6 power units when used for power).

ports.name: Port 2 (485 Bus)
ports.note: Terminal block RS-485 SDN bus connection to a Somfy Data Hub / Power Panel; distributes 40 power units, max 900 ft total wire length.
